headline: EU asks United States to respect the 15% maximum limit on tariffs
summary: The European Commission expects any US measure to respect the 15% maximum tariff limit on EU imports. A spokesperson spoke after the Trump administration proposed new tariffs under Section 301.
why: Tariffs on EU goods affect European exporters and the trade relationship between the EU and the United States, the bloc's largest export market. Section 301 is a US trade law that lets Washington impose duties in response to unfair foreign practices.
original_headline: La UE le pide a Estados Unidos respetar el límite máximo del 15% en los aranceles
